domain.source:
namespace SharedDomain
def next (n : Nat) : Nat := n + 1
def Marker : Prop := True
end SharedDomain

goals.source:
namespace DomainGoals
def First : Prop := forall n : Nat, SharedDomain.next n = n + 1
end DomainGoals

namespace DomainGoals
def Second : Prop := SharedDomain.next 0 = 1
end DomainGoals
